# ☁️ Multi-Cloud Resource Lister / 多云资源清单聚合器

> List resources across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Aliyun in a unified CLI output. / 在统一CLI输出中列出AWS、Azure、GCP和阿里云的资源。

> 🦁 **由 KingAI.Work 出品** — 智能进化｜vip@kingai.work

---

## Who This Is For / 适用人群

• Cloud migration audit: Need to inventory all VMs across AWS and Aliyun before migration—run one command, get the full list in seconds / 云迁移审计：迁移前需盘点AWS和阿里云所有虚拟机，一条命令秒出完整清单
• Cost optimization review: Monthly review of unused resources across Azure and GCP—list all orphaned disks and idle IPs from one place / 成本优化复盘：每月审查Azure和GCP闲置资源，从一处列出所有孤盘和空闲IP
• Compliance snapshot: Before a security audit, gather all network security groups across all clouds for unified reporting / 合规快照：安全审计前，汇总所有云上的网络安全组，生成统一报告

## Core Capabilities / 核心能力

• Unified resource discovery across AWS, Azure, GCP, and Aliyun from one CLI / 从单一CLI统一发现AWS、Azure、GCP和阿里云的资源，告别多平台切换
• Smart region parallel scanning for maximum speed / 智能区域并行扫描，大幅提升资源检索速度
• Automatic credential chain detection and fallback / 自动检测并回退多级凭证链，无需手动配置
• Export results to JSON, CSV, or human-readable table / 将结果导出为JSON、CSV或可读表格，适配不同工作流
• Pro: Cross-cloud resource dependency mapping / Pro版：跨云资源依赖关系映射，一键发现关联资源
• Pro: Custom resource type filtering with saved profiles / Pro版：自定义资源类型过滤并保存配置，重复任务事半功倍

## Try It Now / 立即体验

```bash
multi-cloud-resource-lister --providers aws gcp --resource-type ec2,compute Lists all AWS EC2 instances and GCP Compute instances in a unified output. / 在统一输出中列出所有AWS EC2和GCP Compute实例，无需分别登录控制台。 
```
